facts.fact: Judicial IT Policy Committee chair Kashim Zannah said Borno, Bayelsa, Delta, Niger and Taraba state judiciaries had already adopted similar electronic systems, and that Borno's court documents were kept safe in the cloud through the 2024 Maiduguri flood.

Federal High Court Chief Judge John Tsoho said the court launched its electronic filing system in the Lagos Division, where litigants can file from any location with internet access and fees go through integrated gateways.

NGA.note: Court filing fees through gateways are not tax or fee payment to the revenue authority.
